blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: За ___ (одно лето) сколько новых изб поставили.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. From Дмитрий Мамин-Сибиряк, «Золото».

exercises.q: Эту статую воздвигли десять ___ (годы) назад.
exercises.prompt: This statue was erected ten years ago.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Mary crochets lace every night.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We live in the age of technology.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: His theories on evolution antedate Darwin's by nearly a decade.
exercises.ru: Его теории об эволюции почти на ___ опережают дарвиновские.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'll pick her up in an hour.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Алексей Н. Толстой, «Хождение по мукам»*
exercises.ru: Одной пехоте атак не выдержать, пехота вымоталась за ___.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Хождение по мукам».

exercises.q: Antonio read the book a year ago.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я отниму у тебя всего ___ (минута).
exercises.prompt: I'll just take a minute of your time.
exercises.why: «весь» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Уверен, в ___ (ближайшая неделя) мы отобьём город.
exercises.prompt: I'm certain we're retaking the city within a week.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Нам придётся удвоить наш бюджет на ___ (следующий год).
exercises.prompt: We'll have to double our budget for next year.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Был рад, что через ___ (день) уедет в Петербург.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. From Максим Горький, «Жизнь Клима Самгина».

exercises.q: Молодой человек за ___ (последние дни) сильно изменился в лице.
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. From Антон Чехов, «Шведская спичка».

exercises.q: ___ (неделя) назад мне выдернули зуб.
exercises.prompt: I had a tooth pulled a week ago.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I wash my face every evening to get my makeup off.
exercises.ru: Я умываю лицо ___, чтобы смыть макияж.
exercises.why: «каждый» + a stretch of time, no preposition: accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom is almost always at home on Sundays.
exercises.why: «в» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Look away for a minute! I'm going to quickly change my clothes.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Максим Горький, «Финоген Ильич»*
exercises.ru: А где Варвара Тимофеевна? — через ___ спросил он, оглянув избу.
exercises.why: «через» + accusative. From Максим Горький, «Финоген Ильич».

exercises.q: Which form fits? *Антон Чехов, «На чужбине»*
exercises.why: «за» + accusative. From Антон Чехов, «На чужбине».

exercises.q: He put his magic props on the shelf three months ago.
exercises.ru: Он поставил свои магические реквизиты на полку три ___ назад.
exercises.why: «… назад» (ago): accusative, or genitive after a number — неделю назад, три дня назад. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
